description: Qorix quality gate — deterministic (algorithmic) checks plus an agent-applied semantic checklist, both driven by `qik cortex`.

priming.description: Load the active rules into context before writing or reviewing code.

steps.label: Algorithmic rules
steps.description: Deterministic rule evaluation. Each statement with severity=error blocks.

steps.label: Semantic rules
steps.prompt: For each rule, apply its check_prompt to the changed code (git diff). Answer per rule with PASS, or FAIL plus file:line and reason. Treat any error-severity FAIL as blocking.
steps.description: Semantic rules the binary cannot evaluate; the agent applies each rule's check_prompt.

output.note: `qik cortex --mcp` emits the same JSON shape the qik-mcp server exposes.
